narrative.overview: A control room at night. The page is lacquered black, the gear is lit, and a film grade sits over the whole thing: warm lifted blacks, grain, a faint projector flicker, halation on the highlights. Each plug-in owns one colour, and its page wears it. The renders of the plug-ins as rack gear do the selling. Type and interface stay out of their way: words sit beside the pictures, never on top of them. Personal touches come in on paper. Polaroids, handwritten captions and taped notes make it clear that one person built this.
keyCharacteristics: Dark by default. The only light page is Shunya, which flips to a pale room.
One accent per plug-in, set per page through `--accent`.
A film grade over the stage: grain, flicker, halo, vignette, dust.
Paper and ink for anything personal: polaroids, notes, handwritten captions.
Pills for actions, soft cards for data, square-ish paper for keepsakes.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: A page wears one plug-in's colour. Don't mix two plug-in accents on one page except in navigation strips that list all of them.

rules.name: The Night Stays Night Rule
rules.body: Elements that must stay dark on the pale page use the `--night*` tokens, never `--bg`/`--fg`, which flip there.

rules.name: The Measured Mono Rule
rules.body: Numbers, specs, timings and units are set in IBM Plex Mono with tabular figures.

rules.name: The Film Grade Rule
rules.body: The film grade (grain, flicker, halation, vignette, dust) is part of the identity. Keep it, and keep its reduced-motion fallback: grade and grain stay, still; dust, flicker and rays go.

dos: Do keep pages dark on `--night`. Shunya's pale room is the only light page.
Do give each product page exactly one accent, through `--accent`.
Do keep the film grade and the paper vocabulary (polaroids, handwriting, tape). The owner made both binding.
Do set numbers and specs in IBM Plex Mono.
Do keep words beside the gear renders, never on top of them.
donts: Don't add a light theme or light sections outside Shunya. The owner's decision.
Don't redraw, recolour or replace the lotus logo. A dark backing is the only allowed treatment.
Don't use Reenie Beanie anywhere except on paper.
